name: Guess the Crop
tagline: Can you tell crops from real satellite chips?
description: Real Sentinel-2 imagery, CDL ground truth, year filter 2020–2024. Thirty-three CONUS fields sampled across the country at peak growing season — corn belt, plains wheat, rice delta, cotton south, California orchards. We show you the chip plus the state, county, and year; you pick the crop from a four-option group. Eight rounds per game, score tally, play again. The educational lift is the difficulty itself — sometimes even with real images it's hard, and that's why satellite ag-analytics is non-trivial.
